// @provenance rule: rule_struct
pub struct Payroll {
    hours: u32,
}

// @provenance rule: rule_impl_block
impl Payroll {
    pub fn pays(&self) -> bool {
        self.hours > 38
    }
}

// @provenance rule: rule_enum
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub(crate) enum Shift {
    Day,
}

/// A ledger of entries.
// @provenance rule: rule_generic_struct
#[derive(
    Debug,
    Default,
)]
pub struct Ledger<T> {
    entries: Vec<T>,
}

// @provenance rule: rule_const_fn
pub const fn limit() -> u32 {
    38
}

// @provenance rule: rule_async_fn
pub(crate) async unsafe fn pays_overtime(
    hours: u32,
) -> bool {
    hours > 38
}

// @provenance rule: rule_trait
pub trait Rates {
    fn rate(&self) -> u32;
}

// @provenance rule: rule_alias
pub type Hours = u32;

#[rule("rule_attribute_enum")]
#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum Kind {
    Day,
}

#[rule("rule_attribute_struct")]
pub struct Entry;

// @provenance rule: rule_end
